query_evidence.query: WhatsApp vs contact form for small business website
query_evidence.interpretation: Evidence that small-business owners compare website enquiry routes; it is not verified demand, volume or difficulty.

editorial_decision.distinct_task: Route quick questions, structured project requests and ready-to-schedule consultations into suitable working channels.

limitations: The wording confirms that the comparison question exists; it does not establish search demand or commercial value.
